bio: Johnny Perkins First-Year Social Committee Crimson Yard Hi! My name is Johnny Perkins, and I’m from Overland Park, Kansas, just outside of Kansas City. I live in Hurlbut Hall and hope to concentrate in Statistics or the History of Science. On campus, I’m a contributor to the Harvard International Review and Political Review, as well as a member of WHRB (Harvard’s campus radio station) and the Urban Sustainability Lab (HUUSL). My other loves include baseball, puzzle-solving, biking, writing, and any obscure or underground music. If you have any questions for the committee, feedback on socials, or just want to chat, don’t hesitate to reach out! Looking forward to a fun year.
